correctness.rationale: The event geometry was reconstructed directly. For \(0<h<1\) and \(0<w<1\), conditioning on \(U=u\) gives a single lower threshold for \(V\) above \(a=hw/[1-h(1-w)]\); exact integration yields the displayed CDF. Setting \(t=w(1-w)\) makes the excess \(h^2 t\log(1+A/t)\), \(A=(1-h)/h^2\). Its derivative is \(h^2[\log(1+x)-x/(1+x)]>0\) for \(x=A/t>0\), so the unique maximum is at \(w=1/2\). Independent numerical integration at several interior parameter pairs reproduced the closed form; the endpoint weights reduce to a single uniform p-value. The equal-weight value at \(h=0.05\) and calibrated root also reproduce the stated numbers.
